answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 5406 Country: IT Title: Please advise me is it permissible for a muslim revert to attending the baptism of a family member. With the view of keeping family ties (NB: not the church just the after celebrations), also if the wife refuses must she go if ordered by her husband. Question: As salamu alaikum, Please advise me is it permissible for a muslim revert to attending the baptism of a family member. With the view of keeping family ties (NB: not the church just the after celebrations), also if the wife refuses must she go if ordered by her husband. jazakAllah Answer ID: 5406 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 833/711=B/1429) Attending one?s religious programme amounts to supporting it, therefore it is unlawful for a Muslim to attend the religious programmes of people professing other beliefs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
